findings.message: The tag holds no frame; ID3v2 requires at least one.

The LAME tag CRC of 1 frame covers the frame's first 190 bytes, as ffmpeg writes it, instead of the bytes before the CRC; LAME and ffmpeg itself reject it, so readers that check it ignore the tag's encoder string and ReplayGain. The first at 0x14.
